solution:
**Calculation:**

I. The number of male teachers in school L is 135.44 percent of the number of female teachers in school P.

Number of male teachers in school L = 160

Number of female teachers in school P = 110

(160/110) x 100% ≈ 145.45%

Therefore, the statement I is incorrect. The correct percentage is 145.45% and not 135.44%.
